labels.red: Red — autoclave, microwave or chemical treatment, then shredding
labels.blue: Blue — disinfection, then autoclave or shredding

_comment: Class ORDER is the contract between train.py and the classifier. Index 0 must be yellow in both, forever. Reordering this list silently remaps every prediction a trained checkpoint makes — the model would keep reporting 94% confidence while naming the wrong bin. train.py writes its own class order into the checkpoint and the classifier refuses to load one that disagrees with this file.
